q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution**
Today is August 22, 2026. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026. This means resolution occurs in approximately 4 days.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why**

NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue at approximately $91.0 billion (with ±2% variance, implying a range of roughly $89.2-$92.8 billion). This guidance was issued on May 20, 2026—well before the earnings report date.

With only 4 days until the earnings call, the forward guidance issued by management at the end of Q1 is almost certain to be the actual reported figure (or extremely close to it). Companies rarely revise guidance this close to the actual release date, as they have had months to refine their estimates and would have already accounted for most material changes.

Wall Street consensus as of August 19, 2026 is $91.9 billion—directly in line with NVIDIA's guidance range and suggesting no material downside surprises are expected in the final days before the report.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**

- Unexpected demand deterioration in the final days of August (very unlikely at this stage)
- A major customer cancellation or delay (would have been flagged earlier)
- Geopolitical shock affecting supply chains or China restrictions (possible but would require an extraordinary event in 4 days)
- Significant accounting adjustments or one-time charges (typically telegraphed in advance)

**(d) What would push the value higher?**

- Last-minute enterprise deals closing ahead of schedule (possible but typically baked into guidance by this stage)
- Better-than-expected Data Center bookings not yet factored in (unlikely if guidance was properly conservative)
- Upside from non-Data Center segments (Gaming, Professional Visualization)
- Management deciding to raise guidance at the last minute (very rare this close to release)

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values**

The research explicitly states:
- NVIDIA's forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ±2%** (range: $89.2-$92.8 billion)
- Wall Street consensus (August 19): **$91.9 billion**
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: **$81.6 billion** (for reference on company execution)

The ±2% variance provided by management is tight, suggesting high confidence in their forecast. Companies issuing guidance this close to earnings release (May 20 guidance for late August earnings) are typically accurate within their stated variance bands.

**Reasoning:**

With 4 days to go and NVIDIA having issued specific guidance with a narrow ±2% band, the probability that actual reported revenue falls within or very near the guidance range is extremely high (>95%). The company has had 3+ months since issuing this guidance to observe customer demand, bookings, and supply chain execution.

The resolution criterion asks for "NVIDIA's forward guidance" in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release. Based on the research, management guided to $91.0 billion. This is the most likely figure to be repeated/confirmed in the August 26 earnings call.

The question range of 99.5-115.5 billion is quite wide relative to guidance, but I'm forecasting the central tendency of the actual guidance figure and likely reported revenue (which should match or be extremely close).

Given:
- Narrow guidance band of $89.2-$92.8 billion
- Wall Street consensus at $91.9 billion
- Only 4 days until resolution
- Management credibility on recent forecasts (Q1 came in strong)

My estimate centers on the $91.0 billion guidance figure with relatively tight confidence bounds.

Low (10th percentile): 89200000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92800000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts approximately $91.0 billion, with a plus or minus 2% variance. This outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

For context, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion in Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially, with Data Center revenue reaching $75.2 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Wall Street analysts, as of August 19, 2026, have an average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue at $91.9 billion, placing it within NVIDIA's guidance range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The company's Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
